problem_statement: The CRC calculation support must be generalized so that a single CRC calculator can compute CRC16 (CCITT and ANSI variants) and CRC32-ANSI over arbitrary byte buffers, over a whole object, and over a byte range read from a message. The CRC16-CCITT, CRC16-ANSI and CRC32-ANSI polynomials must be available as named constants. The current CRC16-only implementation cannot express CRC32 and does not provide a unified calculator interface, so a test exercising CRC16 and CRC32 computation over known inputs against a polymorphic CRC calculator cannot be built.
